```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(RPostgres)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
```

```{r connect, include = FALSE}
out_dir <- Sys.getenv("REPORT_OUTPUT_DIR", "reports")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
con <- dbConnect(
  RPostgres::Postgres(),
  host = Sys.getenv("POSTGRES_GOLD_POOL_HOST", "localhost"),
  port = as.integer(Sys.getenv("POSTGRES_GOLD_POOL_PORT", "6432")),
  dbname = Sys.getenv("POSTGRES_GOLD_DB", "lotus_gold_dev"),
  user = Sys.getenv("POSTGRES_GOLD_USER", "lotus_app"),
  password = Sys.getenv("POSTGRES_GOLD_PASSWORD", "")
)
```

## Revenue trend

```{r revenue, echo = FALSE}
revenue_month <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM marts.revenue_by_store_month") |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(revenue = sum(revenue), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(month)
write_csv(revenue_month, file.path(out_dir, "revenue_trend.csv"))
ggplot(revenue_month, aes(x = month, y = revenue, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Revenue") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "revenue_trend.png"), width = 8, height = 4)
```

## Return rate

```{r returns, echo = FALSE}
return_rate <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM marts.return_rate_by_product") |>
  arrange(desc(return_rate))
write_csv(head(return_rate, 20), file.path(out_dir, "return_rate_top20.csv"))
ggplot(head(return_rate, 20), aes(x = reorder(product_id, return_rate), y = return_rate)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Product", y = "Return rate")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "return_rate.png"), width = 8, height = 5)
```

## Ramadan seasonality

```{r ramadan, echo = FALSE}
ramadan <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM marts.ramadan_seasonality") |>
  group_by(is_ramadan) |>
  summarise(revenue = sum(revenue), orders = sum(orders), .groups = "drop")
write_csv(ramadan, file.path(out_dir, "ramadan_seasonality.csv"))
ggplot(ramadan, aes(x = factor(is_ramadan), y = revenue)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Ramadan month", y = "Revenue")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "ramadan_seasonality.png"), width = 6, height = 4)
```

```{r disconnect, include = FALSE}
dbDisconnect(con)
```
